title: Trust-region merit penalty may decay by a factor 0.2 per step (trip crawl HS89/90/91/96)

Group (ip_barrier_stall, unclassified, ip_bound_slack_residual, ip_bound_violation): ip_barrier_stall 2/49 (trip 2/25), ip_bound_slack_residual 1/31, unclassified trip 6/36 (2 from v3), medium union trip 165 -> 172 (+7). Suite 1722 passed (one test adapted: merit_penalty >= penalty_decay * nu0; one added). Gain 10 : 1, so unattended rule: inconclusive, user decides the waiver. title: Funnel end-game fix on top of hyp/termination_missed-lbfgs-signgate (scratch merge)
notes: Scratch worktree hyp/scratch-signgate-combo = stream/b (05378c4, funnel end game) + hyp/termination_missed-lbfgs-signgate + funnel projection refinement. tfip tiny subset: HS86 cured (successful) and DIPIGRI, HS83 successful; HS15 multiplier_solve_failure, HS37 multiplier_solve_failure, HS1 trust_region_collapse still lost. Trace on HS37: slope = ||proj g||^2 is positive (7.6e-12), alpha_c = 850 yet the tangential step is zero because cauchy_decrease = m_f_n - model_f(w_n + t_c) is -3.8e-8 (negative, cancellation/leak at the 1e-8 level of |g|=300), so the Cauchy fallback loses to the CG step (cg = 0) and dm_f_t = 0 -> y-iteration. Replacing it by the analytic alpha*slope - alpha^2/2*curv cures HS15 (successful) but turns HS37 into trust_region_collapse; HS1 unchanged. So the funnel fix is necessary but not sufficient on top of the sign gate; the model-decrease evaluations dm_cg/cauchy in funnel_tangential_step.py should be computed analytically (not as differences of model values).

title: Analytic tangential model decreases (r0.t - t'Ht/2) in the funnel tangential step (float64)
notes: cauchy_decrease and dm_cg were differences of model values, m_f(w_n) - m_f(w_n+t), whose rounding (eps |g_n| |t| with |g_n| = 3e2) exceeds the decrease (1e-9) near a KKT point and gave -3.8e-8 (HS37 trace), so the Cauchy fallback lost and d = 0 (y-iteration deadlock). Now -(g_n.t + t'Ht/2) with g_n.t = -r0.t (t in null(A)). float64 only: the float32 tests of infeasible runs (test_infeasible_run_reports_multiplier_bound_hits, test_step_logging_reports_funnel_columns) otherwise reach max_steps instead of infeasible_stationary_point. Standalone on stream/b (05378c4): multiplier_failure 5/13, unclassified tfip 1/6, tiny tfip +7 gained / 0 lost (HS1, HS15, HS37, HS83, HS86, DIPIGRI all successful), tfip medium union 170 -> 172; trip unchanged. Suite 1720 passed. On top of hyp/termination_missed-lbfgs-signgate (scratch merge hyp/scratch-signgate-analytic): HS83 and DIPIGRI successful but HS1, HS15, HS37, HS86 end trust_region_collapse: with the sign gate the iteration is slower and E0 stalls at 1.4e-6..1.9e-6 (|f| = 32, pi_f at the objective's rounding floor, ~sqrt(eps |f| H)), the forced mu reductions then run mu below atol and the exhausted-exit declares collapse. That is a rounding floor on E(.;0) <= atol, not a Cauchy defect; curing it needs a scaled (relative) stationarity test, i.e. a tolerance decision for the user. Merged into stream/b.

title: Trust-region merit penalty: monotone up to 50, relaxed by 0.2 per step above (private constants)
notes: Supersedes g8-trip-penalty-decay (decay from nu=1: +10/-1, AIRCRFTB lost) and the floor scan: nu_new = max(0.2 nu_old, need, min(nu_old, 50)). title: Trace of PALMER7E asls-craig (tip): a degenerate flat plateau, not a dying step; termination, not a wrong Hessian
notes: No code change. Scripts: scratchpad p7e_trace.py p7e_an.py. PALMER7E: n=8 (A0 A2 A4 A6 A8 A10 K L), K>=0 only bound, 13 data points, y0=ones. Reference f*=10.15389908 (scipy consensus; the SIF value 1.48e-4 is flagged fstar_mismatch and no solver reaches it). The reached stationary face is K->0 where the model is a degree-5 polynomial in X^2: its least-squares SSE is 10.153936 (cond of the basis 5.9e3), and dF/dK = -L*sum(r x^2) = 0 there for any L (degenerate: zero multiplier). Tip results: asls-craig/pcg/pasls f=10.15389864 (gap 4.4e-8) status max_steps_reached (unsolved by status only); minresqlp merit_stagnation; trip/tfip f=10.50/10.40; scipy-slsqp f=10.153976 status successful in 251 steps (stops on ftol 1e-6 on f change; gap 7.6e-6) = solved; asls-pcg-exact successful in 106 steps. Trace asls-craig: f-f* flat at 10.2 from step ~80 and within 1e-4 of the plateau from ~200; |g| falls 3.6 (k=120) -> 2.7e-3 (k=500); K drifts 1.7 -> 0.12 (never 0); mult_lb[K] nonzero in only 2 of 61 sampled iterates; steps do NOT die: |x_k - x_{k-5}| 0.02..5, alpha 0.016..1 erratic; |s|/|Newton step| 0.007..0.27 and cos(s, Newton) flips sign (+0.84 / -0.92 / +0.99 / -0.62). True Hessian at k=500: eigenvalues -3.0e-6, 1.6e-7, 2.0e-3, 0.20, 12.6, 40.9, 1.9e3, 6.7e4 (cond 2.2e10, indefinite); the two near-null eigvecs are the A0<->L redundancy and the A2/K/L trade-off. Model B is positive definite with the same spread (2.4e-6 .. 9.1e4) but its curvature along the steps is off by 100x (too soft: 1.7e-5 vs 1.65e-3 at k=200; 7.5e-6 vs 3.2e-4 at k=300; 3.6x too stiff at k=500). Conclusion: not cycling in the active set and not a vanishing step; the iterate crawls along a degenerate valley with noise-level curvature and the gradient-based stop is never met in 500 steps; scipy 'solves' it by stopping on f change.
